selectionPolicy: Only source-marked noun readings; other parts of speech and their definitions are excluded. Homographs are retained only in the noun reading. Existing single-word/common-noun/modern-spelling filters retained. Academic-only OCR candidates are quarantined.
reuseNotice: Includes Belemle-derived data with unspecified reuse terms; see ATTRIBUTION.md.

identicalRussianTranslationFilter.rule: Remove a headword when any Russian translation alternative has identical NFC spelling, ignoring case, parenthetical explanations and dictionary usage labels. Bashkir letters and е/ё remain distinct. Entries without Russian definitions cannot be checked.

excludedEndingsFilter.rule: Literal word endings, irrespective of root origin or morphological analysis

maximumLengthFilter.rule: Exclude all headwords longer than 12 letters

rootEndingExceptions.basis: Contemporary morphological analysis; lexical roots and compound constituents are not removed as productive -лыҡ suffixes. Not a complete manually certified morphemic dictionary.

explicitlyRestoredEndingWords.reason: Explicit user request; does not certify morphemic analysis

senseAwareTurkicRestoration.rule: Explicitly restore only selected Turkic noun senses, preserving other exclusion rules. Identical Russian spelling alone does not exclude these approved senses.
senseAwareTurkicRestoration.russianTranslationAddedForTol: вдова; вдовец, editorial translation of saved English gloss widow; widower

translationEnrichment.method: Exact headword lookup; noun readings only; academic noun cross-references resolved when unambiguous; 37 saved English glosses translated editorially with provenance.
translationEnrichment.validation: Automatic source-based checks and a sample review; not complete manual linguistic proofreading.
translationEnrichment.remainingPolicy: Keep untranslated words in the full and bonus lexicons; they cannot become crossword targets without a confirmed Russian definition.

onlyIdenticalRussianTranslationFilter.rule: Remove only headwords whose every nonempty Russian translation alternative equals the headword after NFC, case folding, dictionary-label and parenthetical removal. Preserve headwords with any other Russian translation and those without a Russian definition. Bashkir letters and е/ё remain distinct.

mixedTranslationUserFilter.rule: Remove words from the historical list of 185 mixed Russian-translation matches, except explicit user exceptions; preserve the ten previously selected Turkic noun meanings, restoring missing entries from their curated archived record.

borUserRemoval.reason: Explicit user request; supersedes previous exception for бор
